thread:
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked for change window 2024-05-12 09:00Z — remote cache reported lease eviction on upload of artifact shard; canary 2/4 failing. Holding promotion.

ashley: I see cache PUTs failing with 412 Precondition Failed from cache service, looks like lease expired mid-upload. Upload retried but blobs are truncated.

praveen: logs show rapid GC on cache nodes during 08:58-09:01Z. Possible misconfigured eviction TTL after yesterday's config change.

ci-bot: Test matrix results: canary-a: fail tests related to missing wheel files; canary-b: timeout during artifact fetch. See CI link: https://ci.internal/build/98765

ops-oncall: can we pin to the last-known-good image (rel-20240511-9f7) to keep change window? New build (rel-20240512-c1d) has missing artifacts.

ashley: option 1: pin to rel-20240511-9f7 now and promote. Option 2: pause and force cache GC pause + reupload (risk missing change window). Which is lower risk?

praveen: quick mitigation: increase cache lease TTL and disable GC sweep for 10m, then kick reupload of missing shards. But that requires infra deploy which may take ~6m. Change window ends 09:15Z.

ops-oncall: timeboxed: if not green by 09:06Z, pin.

ashley: starting infra change now (disable GC sweep).

(monitoring)

praveen: infra change applied, GC sweep paused. Triggering artifact reupload from build artifacts service.

ci-bot: Reupload started, artifact sharding upload retries = 5.

ashley: reupload still flickering — some shards succeed, others 412 again. Root cause likely race between uploader and cache node eviction due to memory pressure.

ops-oncall: decision time — 09:06Z reached. Recommend pin to rel-20240511-9f7.

ashley: /deploybot pin image=rel-20240511-9f7 reason="remote-cache lease evictions during change window" initiated by ashley

deploy-bot: Image pinned to rel-20240511-9f7 by ashley. Promotion resumed. Canary checks now 4/4 passing.

praveen: promoted. Created follow-up ticket: increase cache node memory, add eviction alerts, and regression test for lease TTL behavior.

ops-oncall: Updated release notes: 'Temporarily pinned to rel-20240511-9f7 due to remote-cache lease eviction during shard uploads; follow-up infra work scheduled.'

ashley: filing incident and assigning to infra team for root-cause and postmortem. Will roll forward after cache stability validated. :white_check_mark:
